usage.outputShape: body.image_url (hosted fal.media PNG URL of the cutout); also body.width, body.height, body.file_size_bytes, body.content_type, body.source_url
quirks: Returns a JSON object with a HOSTED result URL (body.image_url, a fal.media PNG) — NOT raw PNG binary. This differs from the dellbot backend in prior usage which returned raw PNG bytes. Fetch body.image_url to download the cutout.

Large source images can fail: a full-res ~2MB Wikipedia JPG returned HTTP 502 {error:'Background removal failed: Unprocessable Entity'} AND still charged $0.08. Use a reasonably sized, directly-accessible image URL.
Price is $0.08 (registry surface), confirmed charged on both the failed and successful call — a 502 does NOT refund.
Pass the image as a public URL in the 'image_url' field; the backend processes via fal and crops to bbox=false by default.
usage.guide: POST to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/remove-bg with a JSON body {"image_url": "<public image URL>"} and pay $0.08 USDC on Base via x402. On success you get HTTP 200 with a JSON object whose image_url field is a hosted fal.media PNG of the transparent cutout — fetch that URL to download the result. Use a moderately sized, directly fetchable image; oversized or unprocessable images return a 502 error and still charge you (no refund).
